items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: So Lee Langster, the leader and I have become such good friends.

ctx.x: Madison, Wisconsin. So Lee Langster, the leader and I have become such good friends. And since I became his friend all the guys had gotten close to him. He didn't stay in the band after that, he just quit and went back to Chicago. I never heard of him again.
